status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY OUTCOME. No policy has been trained or evaluated under this channel.
question: Is there a randomization channel and severity at which equal-budget direct training does NOT reach the target, while a staged approach does? That is the regime in which a curriculum is necessary rather than optional, and we have not found one.
why_we_need_it: Every channel measured so far is a bounded, memoryless perturbation of a task the policy already solves: a fixed-DR policy keeps 0.82 success with all five physics channels doubled, and the best single-channel loss is push at 3x (0.746). With no barrier anywhere in that space, staging the approach to a difficulty direct training already reaches cannot help, which is consistent with every curriculum result in this project tying fixed randomization.

the_candidate.channel: motor thermal derating: available torque falls as a joint heats, and heating is driven by the joint's own torque
why_it_is_real: Unitree documents a thermal derating strategy on the G1 that limits current when a high-load joint such as the knee exceeds its safe temperature, and states that continuous operation ends in either a flat battery or that derating (https://www.unitree.com/g1/, teardown coverage).

Our simulator has no such limit. robots/g1.py sets effort_limit_sim to the PEAK rating (139 N.m knee and hip, 88 hip yaw and waist yaw, 50 feet and waist) and applies it forever, so a policy trained here may draw peak torque indefinitely and the robot it targets may not.
This is therefore a documented sim-to-real gap on the exact robot, not a difficulty invented to make a curriculum look good.
why_it_is_different_in_kind: ENDOGENOUS: heating is driven by the policy's own torque, so an inefficient policy creates its own harder environment. No other channel here does that.
ACCUMULATING: the constraint arrives late in an episode, so early-episode reward says little about whether the episode survives.
REQUIRES A GLOBAL CHANGE: a torque budget cannot be reacted out of; the policy has to move more economically.
Our own measurements say it will discriminate: torque saturation at the envelope spans 0.005 to 0.058 across arms, a factor of twelve, while success at the same cell spans 8 points.
the_candidate.model: dT/dt = (tau/tau_peak)^2 / heat_tau - T / cool_tau, available = tau_peak * (1 - depth * clip((T-onset)/(1-onset),0,1)); heating goes as torque squared because ohmic loss goes as current squared and current is proportional to torque
the_candidate.implementation: gear_sonic/research/practice_utility/thermal.py, 20 CPU tests. lam = 0 is a bit-identical no-op, pinned by test.
the_candidate.integration_point: a ThermalImplicitActuator mirroring SONIC's existing DelayedImplicitActuator: override compute() to clamp computed_effort to the budget and advance the state with the DELIVERED torque. Not yet written; it needs a GPU smoke test before it is trusted.

stated_assumptions.continuous_over_peak: 0.5. Unitree publishes peak torque and documents derating without giving a curve; brushless servo actuators of this class sustain roughly half their peak indefinitely. This is an assumption, and it is the first thing to replace with a bench measurement.
stated_assumptions.heat_seconds: 4.0 s of sustained peak torque to the onset at lam = 1, chosen so the effect is visible inside a 4 s clip. A real motor's constant is minutes. This is a modelling choice about timescale, and it is what the severity ladder scales.

the_risk_we_are_running.threat: Designing a channel until a curriculum wins on it is fitting the benchmark to the method. A win obtained that way would mean nothing.
mitigations: The channel was chosen on documented-deployment grounds and closes a specific, nameable gap between our simulator and the target robot.
The severity ladder is fixed NOW, from the thermal model's own onset formula, before any outcome exists. It is not adjusted after seeing results; any change is a dated amendment with a reason.

The result is reported as a MAP, not as a win: every severity at which direct training already succeeds is reported as a severity where a curriculum is unnecessary. A map with a small necessary region is the honest finding, and is still the first such map we know of for humanoid randomization.

Direct training failing is not the claim. The claim needs BOTH that direct training fails AND that the target is reachable some other way. A severity that nothing reaches is an unlearnable task, not a curriculum result.

severity_ladder_fixed_now.chosen_from: tools/thermal_ladder from sustained_duty_to_onset: seconds of constant duty before a COLD joint begins to derate. The reference clip is 4 s.
severity_ladder_fixed_now.reading: lam 0.5 essentially never bites within a 4 s clip below 60% duty, so it is the built-in 'curriculum unnecessary' control. lam 1 bites for duty >= 0.6, lam 2 for duty >= 0.4, lam 3 for duty >= 0.35. An episode that starts warm derates sooner than these cold-start figures.

P0_does_it_bite_at_all.what: score the five existing frozen policies (fixed, never-shrink, collapsed, no-DR, and the gate) on the five severities, 512 episodes per cell
P0_does_it_bite_at_all.decides: whether the channel constrains a competent policy at a physically defensible severity, and whether it separates policies that the current channels barely separate
P0_does_it_bite_at_all.stop_rule: if no severity in the ladder drops fixed@s8600 below 0.90 success, the channel is not a barrier candidate at this model's timescale and the direction stops here rather than being retuned until it bites

P1_where_does_direct_training_fail.cost: about 5 GPU-h warm start, then about 11 GPU-h from scratch on the two severities that bracket the transition
P1_where_does_direct_training_fail.what: train directly AT each severity that P0 shows bites, equal budget, same origin and seed; then repeat from scratch at the bracketing severities
P1_where_does_direct_training_fail.decides: the severity at which equal-budget direct training stops reaching the target. Everything below it is a region where a curriculum is unnecessary, and is reported as such

P2_only_where_a_barrier_exists.what: at a severity where direct training fails: direct, a preset schedule reaching the same final severity, and the probe-gated curriculum, matched on budget, environments, mixture and seed, paired
P2_only_where_a_barrier_exists.decides: whether staging crosses the barrier, and whether feedback adds anything over a preset schedule that reaches the same place
P2_only_where_a_barrier_exists.note: beating direct training is the low bar and does not establish that feedback helps; the preset schedule is the comparison that matters

frozen_decision_rules.B1_bites: P0 must show fixed@s8600 below 0.90 success at some ladder severity, else stop.
frozen_decision_rules.B2_barrier: A barrier exists at severity S only if BOTH direct training at S falls at least 10 points below direct training at lam 0, AND some staged run reaches within 5 points of the lam 0 level at S. Direct failing alone is an unlearnable task, not a barrier.
frozen_decision_rules.B3_report_the_unnecessary_region: Every severity at which direct training reaches the target is reported as a severity where a curriculum is unnecessary. This is part of the result, not an omission.
frozen_decision_rules.B4_no_retuning: The ladder, the thermal constants and the margins are fixed in this document. Changing any of them after seeing an outcome requires a dated amendment stating what was seen and why the change is not fitting.
frozen_decision_rules.B5_efficiency_is_the_mechanism_to_check: If a curriculum crosses a barrier, report the energy proxy and torque saturation of the crossing policy. The claimed mechanism is that it learned to move economically; if its effort is unchanged, the explanation is wrong even though the outcome is right.

what_this_cannot_show: That curricula help in general. It can show a regime where one is necessary on this robot, this task and this channel.
Anything about the real robot's thermal behaviour: the constants are assumptions, and the timescale is compressed so an effect fits inside a 4 s clip.
Anything at all until P0 runs; the channel has never been applied to a policy.
